title: metadata save door: a select field bound to a picklist no package declares saves and publishes, then is served with no options and every write to it is refused
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGDmSYVyFomEEAdU3

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing point and a reproduction (reach: the public metadata doors `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME?mode=draft&package=PKG` and `POST /api/v1/packages/PKG/publish-drafts`, then the data door; reproduced twice, once with a `select` and once with a `multiselect`).
Business reason: an author (or an agent writing metadata over the API) binds a field to a picklist by name and misspells it, or names a list from a package that is not installed. Both doors answer success and the draft reads `_diagnostics.valid: true`, so nothing tells the author. The published object then cannot store a single record with that field set, and the boot does not refuse it either. Boot and late-install loading already refuse this exact shape (`describeUnresolvedPicklistReferences`), so the authoring path is the one door that lets it through.
Reader who acts: `domain:server`, the object save door in `packages/metadata-protocol` (the same pre-flight #29790 added for registry refusals) and the publish promote gate; the resolver is `packages/objectql/src/picklist-resolution.ts`.
Dedupe (open and closed): `picklist unresolved` 25 hits, `picklist "no options"` 70, `describeUnresolvedPicklistReferences` 0. Nearest: #19519 (closed, the runtime resolver), #26886 (closed, a diagnostics false positive on picklist-only fields), #28659 (closed, `label()` on an option-less field). None covers an unresolved picklist name at the authoring doors.

QA-source: #29893 · studio-authoring.picklist-bound-select · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Measured at framework `589049b0` (main, 2026-11-03) on a stock showcase boot, as admin, in a runtime package.

1. `POST /api/v1/packages` `{"id":"com.qa.x","name":"X","version":"0.1.0","namespace":"x","type":"app"}` → 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/x_probe?mode=draft&package=com.qa.x` `{"name":"x_probe","label":"Probe","sharingModel":"public_read_write","fields":{"name":{"type":"text","label":"Name"},"t":{"type":"select","label":"T","picklist":"nope_list"}}}` → **200**, draft `_diagnostics: {valid: true}`.
3. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.x/publish-drafts` `{}` → **200**, `outcome: published`.
4. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/x_probe` → field `t` is `{type: select, picklist: "nope_list"}` with no options.
5. `POST /api/v1/data/x_probe` `{"name":"a","t":"bronze"}` → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`: "T takes its values from picklist \"nope_list\", which no loaded package declares". Every value is refused.
6. A restart keeps the object published; the boot does not refuse it.

**Expected:** step 2 (and step 3 for a draft stored another way) refuses `422 INVALID_METADATA` naming the field and the undeclared picklist, as the load doors do. The resolver's own header says such a field is "never a field served with no options".

Controls that hold: `picklist: ""` → 422; `picklist` together with `options` → 422; `picklist` on a `text` field → 422 ("only valid on an option type"). Studio's own picker offers only declared picklists, so this is reached through the API (or an agent), not through Studio's picker.

## Mechanism (read at 589049b0)

`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` calls `describeUnresolvedPicklistReferences` (`packages/objectql/src/picklist-resolution.ts:200`) when it loads packages at boot and on a late install, and refuses the load. The runtime save door in `packages/metadata-protocol` does not ask that question, and neither does the publish promote. #29790 added `objectRegistrationRefusal` to the save door for registry refusals; picklist resolution is not one of its doors.
